description.value: 350 Bakehouse and Cafe is a scratch bakery and espresso café in Kelowna founded in 2017 by a fifth-generation Dutch baker. Everything on the menu is made fresh daily in-house, from classic glazed donuts and croissants to savoury cruffins and sausage rolls. Cyclists will find a full espresso bar, grab-and-go deli sandwiches, and daily hot lunch specials — plus catering available for larger groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active bakery-café at 1892 Spall Road, Kelowna, matching all OSM contact details. The menu and catering pages provide detailed food/drink evidence; neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike infrastructure, washrooms, or Wi-Fi, so those fields default to null per the absence-of-evidence rule. Takeout and grab-and-go are explicitly confirmed; vegetarian options and dairy-free substitutes are explicitly listed on the menu.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, established bakery-café with grab-and-go food, espresso, and pickup ordering — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists passing through Kelowna. Bike infrastructure is unconfirmed and should be verified on-site.

Packed lunches.detail: Grab-and-go cooler with individually wrapped deli sandwiches (Ham & Havarti, Roast Beef, Clubhouse, Honey Pepper Turkey & Ham, Pesto Chicken with Bacon, Veggie, and more) available for takeaway
